Metadata and warnings of a result

Source: R/results.R
soil_metadata.Rd

soil_metadata() returns what the API and the client recorded about a read: request (the body sent) and endpoint, api_version, schema_version, client_version, retrieved_at (UTC), request_ids (one per page, quote them when reporting a problem), pages, complete (FALSE for a partial result) and next_offset (the offset to continue from), total_count (NA for the wide layout: the API does not count), warnings, variables (see soil_columns()), view and revised (see soil_revised_rules()), first_layer (see soil_first_layer()), components and min_cumulative_percent (when a component dataset is selected), crs, datasets (the catalog rows of the datasets read: what soil_citations() reads) and multi_value_rule ("mean": the value of a multi-value WoSIS cell in the numeric column).

Usage

soil_metadata(x)

soil_warnings(x)

Arguments

x

A soil_table (or a summary or export result). Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

soil_metadata(): a list. soil_warnings(): a character vector.

Details

soil_warnings() returns the warnings of the API over all pages, once each: mixed units in a column, multi-value cells, renamed columns, collapsed duplicate measurements, component ties, component proportions not summing to 100.

See also

Other results: soil_columns(), soil_first_layer(), soil_flags(), soil_markings(), soil_revised_rules(), soil_table

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- soil_observations(soil, datasets = "wosis_points", country = "KEN")
soil_metadata(x)$request_ids
soil_warnings(x)
} # }
